High tier: two independent origins agree on operator. Did not re-verify Diameter/Length (sheet gives Diameter=32, LengthKnownKm=130 -- plausibly the new 30km Structure-E tie-in plus the existing ~100km Sabratha-Mellitah trunk, but that combination wasn't a flagged question here, so I left it alone).
